comment: Enjoyable, laid-back class. Minimal out-of-class work, does not require you to memorize anything, graded on overall improvement from the start of the semester, very understanding person, and fun guest lectures!

Prof. Wilkerson is so funny! She always finds ways to brighten up the classroom.  You will have homework maybe once a week which will be to write a speech. Prof. Wilkerson brought in different people to talk to us about their public speaking experiences.
she is super kind and deeply cares about her students
she is an amazing professor she grade wondaful is laid back just do you work

Dr. Wilkerson is a fun and laid back professor. She creates a very safe and casual environment to practice public speaking, which is perfect for an introductory course. She may not remember your name but she will make class fun. Would recommend! Fun, easy and useful class

Dr Wilkerson owns a separate business and teaches at VCU. She gave us 5 assignments for a grade, and we only had three speeches throughout the course, plus our final. There are many guest speakers, and if you have an assignment due, there isn't class. She wants you to feel confident and be prepared for the world, and doesn't stress the small stuff.
